exams.subject_km: វិញ្ញាសាទី២៥

questions.label: a
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=1. Factor both: 1-x^2=-(x-1)(x+1) and x^2-3x+2=(x-1)(x-2). Cancel (x-1), leaving -(x+1)/(x-2); substitute x=1.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=3. Rationalize the numerator (multiply by sqrt(x+6)+3) to get (x-3)/(sqrt(x+6)+3); factor denominator x^3-27=(x-3)(x^2+3x+9). Cancel (x-3), leaving 1/[(sqrt(x+6)+3)(x^2+3x+9)].

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0, direct application of the standard sinc limit with k=5: write as 5·5·(sin 5x)/(5x).
